title: Vehicle mode does not stop after bluetooth is disconnected, causing 'speak readings' to continue.
symptom: Vehicle mode does not stop after bluetooth is disconnected, causing 'speak readings' to continue. Users report that after updating to Android 14, xDrip no longer exits Vehicle mode when leaving the car, and the log shows repeated 'Vehicle mode: Enabled' prints without a corresponding 'Disabled' print.
cause: The issue appears to be related to Android 14 updates on various devices, as multiple users report the problem after updating to Android 14. The exact root cause is not explicitly stated, but it is implied that the Android update broke the bluetooth disconnect detection that triggers Vehicle mode exit.
fix: The fix is to update to the xDrip release of May 12, 2024 or any after that. Users confirm that this version fixed the problem. As a temporary workaround, users can disable 'Vehicle mode' under xDrip+ Motion tracking to stop the ongoing speak readings.
evidence_quote: Please try the xDrip release of May 12, 2024 or any after that and if the problem persists, please report it here.
